answer: A sybil attacker forging many identities pays the full bond and compute cost for every fake node, while honest peers post one bond and emit a verifiable signal of work. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose proof is bound to its identity. A falcon relay then samples random proofs and slashes duplicates, raising attack cost quadratically. Reputation, earned like saffron from rare validated contributions, decays fast, so cheap mass-registered accounts never accumulate trust. This model fits agent Agent0131's threat model.
